title: Secondment of Public Officers to Trade Associations
what_it_is: Secondment of Public Officers to Trade Associations

sections.label: LEAD+ programme for TACs
sections.summary: The LEAD+ programme was introduced at Budget 2016 to help Trade Associations and Chambers raise their internal competencies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: The Local Enterprise and Association Development-Plus (LEAD+) programme was introduced at Budget 2016 to help Trade Associations and Chambers (TACs) raise their internal competencies.

sections.label: Approved LEAD+ projects and funding
sections.summary: As of March 2017, SPRING approved eight LEAD+ projects at up to $8.1 million, spearheaded by eight named associations, with support for seconding public officers to TACs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: As of March 2017, the Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board (SPRING) has approved eight LEAD+ projects, at up to $8.1 million in total funding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: These projects are spearheaded by the Federation of Merchants' Associations, Singapore (FMAS), Singapore Food Manufacturers' Association (SFMA), Singapore Infocomm Technology Federation (SiTF), Singapore Logistics Association (SLA), Singapore Manufacturing Federation (SMF), Singapore Precision Engineering and Technology Association (SPETA), Singapore Furniture Industries Council (SFIC) and Restaurant Association of Singapore (RAS).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Under LEAD+, support is available for the secondment of public officers to TACs to help strengthen their management and processes as well as drive industry transformation.

sections.label: Seconded officers to TACs
sections.summary: Thirteen officers have been seconded since 2013, with two more confirmed since LEAD+ launched in 2016, including one SPRING officer seconded to SFMA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Under this arrangement, 13 officers have been seconded since 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Since the launch of LEAD+ in 2016, two more officers have confirmed their secondment with TACs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: For example, one officer from SPRING has been seconded to SFMA to assist them in strengthening their internal management capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: This includes developing a succession plan for leadership renewal, putting in place systems to better engage and manage members, and enhancing the existing governance framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: We will continue to facilitate more of such win-win secondment arrangements for interested TACs.
